The tier cell it comes from (t0_54_lifse_simplemlp_wq_s4_nobias, 0.9618 deployed) is not exportable on the stock crossbar and never was: its hard cores are 257 logical slots wide against a 127-slot effective fan-in, and its weight grid reaches |w|=15 against a cell that holds [-7, 7]. The readout core can emit 133 events in a cycle against the 127 ceiling. Decoded from the mapping: core 0 (257 slots -> 10 classes) theta=409, max positive column sum 1444, bound 133; core 1 theta=159 bound 18; core 2 theta=84 bound 108. theta is the divisor in that bound AND the folded quantization scale, so the lever the refusal names is the temporal grid, not the geometry and not the weight cell -- see the S=8 and S=16 siblings.
